svg.title: Fair planner clears per move against completions K — interior maximum near K=256
svg.desc: Fair planner clears per move against completions K — interior maximum near K=256. Arm B (fully fair planner) on the eight master tapes 0xa5230000-0xa5230007, 400-move cap, pooled clears per move (finding-07 section 1). The H=7 K=1024 point is from finding-12 section 3 and is a 6-of-8-tape subset (arm stopped at six games after four hours); on the same six tapes K=256 measures 2.2125, so the visible turnover is a paired -0.1178. That point belongs to a different sample than the rest of the H=7 series and is labelled as such. finding-07's 'still climbing at K=256' prose is withdrawn by finding-12: the series is unimodal, not asymptotic. Flat dashed series are recorded constants: the clairvoyant planners at the same horizon (2.3496 at H=5, 2.3601 at H=7, finding-07 section 1) and the exact survival requirement 2.400 = 12/5 (finding-01); the generator has no reference-line primitive, so each is drawn as a two-point polyline. The x axis is linear; a log axis was recommended in the plan but is not expressible by the generator. Evidence tier: exploratory; the eight-tape figures are cohort-inflated per finding-12 (fresh-tape values live in flow-requirement-gap). Sources: docs/exploratory/finding-07-fair-planning-ceiling.md, docs/exploratory/finding-12-fair-planner-ceiling-extended.md, docs/exploratory/finding-01-score-is-survival.md.
